metadata.value: This repository contains the [code](/fisher-information), [data](/fisher-information/data) and [results](/fisher-information/results) for a framework for determining the maximum information gain and optimising experimental design in neutron reflectometry experiments using the Fisher information (FI).

metadata.value: determining the maximum information gain and optimising experimental design in neutron reflectometry experiments using the Fisher information
metadata.normalized_value: Determining the maximum information gain and optimizing experimental design in neutron reflectometry using the Fisher information
metadata.evidence: In neutron reflectometry experiments, the FI can be analytically calculated and used to provide sub-second predictions of parameter uncertainties.
metadata.reason: Describes the scientific task/method addressed by the artifact

metadata.evidence: The FI provides a lower bound on parameter estimation uncertainties and these are shown to decrease with the square root of measurement time, providing useful information for the planning and scheduling of experimental work.
metadata.reason: Names the core method used in this framework
